name: Montage Linen Shirt
description: Effortlessly refined, our Montage Linen Shirt is cut from 100% European stonewashed linen. Relaxed in fit, precise in finish — a wardrobe cornerstone for warm-weather living.

name: Balboa Linen Trousers
description: Wide-leg, high-rise linen trousers with a pleated front and side-tab waist. Tailored to move beautifully, finished with invisible side-seam pockets.

name: Catalina Silk Slip Dress
description: Cut on the bias from 22mm silk charmeuse, the Catalina drapes with liquid precision. A deep V-back and adjustable straps let it move from morning to evening effortlessly.

name: Harbor Cotton Blazer
description: A single-button blazer in deadstock Italian cotton canvas — structured at the shoulder, relaxed at the hem. Unlined for breathability, precise where it counts.

name: Dune Ribbed Knit Top
description: A slim-fit ribbed top in a soft cotton-cashmere blend. The elongated hem and subtle stretch make it a seamless layering piece across all seasons.

name: Cove Leather Belt
description: Hand-stitched in full-grain vegetable-tanned leather. A wide 4cm profile with a minimal matte brass buckle — the detail that completes the look.
